subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If a candidate review artifact is pre-existing, worker-authored without the fresh launched-attempt proof, bound to another attempt/proposal/revision, not the broker-receipted artifact, or carries missing, replayed, mismatched, or otherwise unauthentic attribution proof, then the system shall reject it without clearing the obligation, append EVT-15 with `failure_class=artifact_untrusted`, preserve the succeeded EVT-10, retain review-only pending work, and expose the expected versus observed non-secret receipt/proof identities without exposing raw attribution material
intent: implementation remains succeeded; review remains pending and run-red with an attributable security failure
fit_criterion: one adversarial fixture per trigger is rejected, same-author and different-author transport are accepted when receipt/proof match, no secret is emitted, `review_artifact_untrusted` increments, implementation never relaunches, and verification occurs only after a newly launched reviewer produces an authentic exact-revision artifact
